description: This file is the entry point of a React-based frontend application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, the CSS styling, and the main AppShell component. It initializes the React app by creating a root and rendering the AppShell component within React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the component tree into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM node.
